# World VR Mall

> World VR Mall (https://worldvrmall.com) is a free 3D virtual shopping mall built in Denver, Colorado and open to the world. Independent stores and brands from every continent have walk-in 3D storefronts; every buy button links to the brand's own checkout. It works in any browser on phones, laptops, and VR headsets (WebXR) with no app to install. Around the mall is a park with three roller coasters, a Sky Wheel, a carousel, a lake with a cruise ship, two duck ponds, an old-world market for makers, a train, an airport, a playground, a roller rink, and a volleyball court. Opened 2026. Operated by Eye To Ad Media (https://eyetoad.com), 1001 Bannock St #660, Denver, CO 80204. Phone 1-800-481-8638.

## Key facts
- Free to visit; no accounts, no login, no ads, no chat with strangers. Kid-safe by design.
- Purchases happen on each brand's own website; World VR Mall never handles payment or customer data.
- Visitor selfie avatars and shopping lists are stored only in the visitor's browser.
- Brands lease a storefront month to month; setup takes about ten minutes by phone; pricing depends on placement (Grand Lobby premium, wing storefront, food court kiosk, Old World Market booth). Call 1-800-481-8638.
- Mall layout: Grand Lobby, Americas Wing, Europe Wing, Asia & Islands Wing, Global Food Court, Kids' Discovery Zone, Aquarium Garden, Sky Deck. A roller coaster (the Mall Blaster) runs through the mall interior.

## Pages
- [Outside world / home](https://worldvrmall.com/): teleport station, park, coasters, lake, market, train, airport, playground; FAQ.
- [Inside the mall](https://worldvrmall.com/mall/): all wings, stores, food court, kids' zone, leasing office; full store directory.
- [Lease a store](https://worldvrmall.com/lease/): what a storefront includes, placement tiers, setup steps, callback form.
- [All stores](https://worldvrmall.com/stores/): every store grouped by wing, with open storefronts marked.
- [About](https://worldvrmall.com/about/): why it exists, who built it, how to visit, privacy, press boilerplate.

## Contact
- Phone: 1-800-481-8638
- Leasing: https://worldvrmall.com/lease/

- [Every country](https://worldvrmall.com/countries/): all 195 countries invited; each gets its own street as its first stores open; multi-language clerks; one sign-up form.

## Pricing (founding tenant rates, 2026)
- Storefront: $99/mo, up to 8 products, AI clerk, buy buttons to the tenant's own site.
- Storefront + Search Optimized: $199/mo, up to 25 products, plus a search-optimized store page at worldvrmall.com/stores/<brand>/.
- Extra products: $10/mo per 5. Rates locked 12 months for 2026 sign-ups; expected to rise in 2027.
- Add-ons: premium lobby placement, logo file install & hosting $25/mo, billboard $100/mo, custom attraction $299/mo, custom features by quote.
